title: ホープフルSの後に・大三角は描かれる

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega's resolve pays off, and she runs spectacularly in the Hopeful Stakes. She sets her sights on the Classic Triple Crown for even greater glory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inspired, Narita Top Road secures first place in her own race the following day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As these classmates bloom one after the other, so too does the excitement surrounding their generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With such strong contenders in the mix, we begin our training for the Satsuki Sho, the first race of the Classic Triple Crown.
